CustomField.description: FCRM-848 This field is created to show the icon for the type of the last communication received for the concerned case.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(Freight_lastcomstype__c, 'Email'), ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'Web'), CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'Qantas Freight')) , HYPERLINK("/lightning/r/"+freight_Last_Comm_ID__c+"/view", IMAGE("https://qantas.lightning.force.com/servlet/servlet.ImageServer?id=0152v00000IRHhe&oid=00D8s00000IDoz7&lastMod=1647355817000", "Email",20, 20)) +' '+ If(Hour(TIMENOW())>Hour(TIMEVALUE(FreightLastCommDate__c)), Text(Hour(TIMENOW())- Hour(TIMEVALUE(FreightLastCommDate__c))+(Today()-DATEVALUE(FreightLastCommDate__c))*24), Text(Hour(TIMEVALUE(FreightLastCommDate__c))- Hour(TIMENOW())+(Today()-DATEVALUE(FreightLastCommDate__c))*24))+ ' Hours Ago' , null)
CustomField.label: Last Communication
